0.0.n: さん makes this way of addressing the audience polite and friendly.

0.1.n: A standard daytime greeting; its final は is pronounced わ.

0.3.n: This is the first part of the name まこと, split across two subtitle tokens.

0.4.n: This completes the name まこと; it is not a separate word here.

0.5.n: This polite ending follows the speaker’s name; Japanese leaves out I here.

1.0.n: This time word sets when the filming will happen.

1.1.n: Attached to 今日, it means today too, suggesting filming on other days as well.

1.2.n: This English borrowing names the video she plans to film.

1.3.n: を marks Vlog as what she will film.

1.4.n: 撮る becomes 撮って, followed by いく for proceeding with the activity and たい for wanting to.

1.5.n: と marks the preceding wish as the content of 思います.

1.6.n: The polite form of 思う; after たいと, it gently expresses what she intends to do.

2.0.n: This sets the day for her description of her outfit.

2.1.n: The speaker refers to herself as the person wearing the top.

2.2.n: が marks 私 as the person doing the wearing.

2.3.n: This emphasizes what she is wearing at this moment.

2.4.n: 着る in て-form plus いる describes the ongoing state of having clothing on.

2.5.n: A slightly polite way to point out the top she is showing.

2.6.n: の connects こちら to トップス, forming this top.

2.7.n: Despite its English-looking plural ending, トップス can refer to a single upper-body garment.

2.8.n: は marks the top as the topic she will describe.

2.9.n: This is the clothing brand’s name; here it identifies where her top is from.

2.10.n: な connects the brand name to explanatory んです; it is required after a noun here.

2.11.n: ん is shortened の and adds an explanatory tone in んです.

2.12.n: です makes the explanation polite as part of なんです.

2.13.n: けど gently links this introduction to what follows, without requiring a strong contrast.

3.0.n: This is the clothing brand’s name.

3.1.n: の connects the brand name to アイテム, identifying the items as belonging to that brand.

3.2.n: This borrowed word refers to clothing or other products from the brand.

3.3.n: を marks the items as what she will introduce.

3.4.n: This names the video in which she will show the items.

3.5.n: の links Vlog to 中 to express being within the vlog.

3.6.n: Together with Vlogの and で, this places the introductions within the video.

3.7.n: で marks the setting where the introducing happens.

3.8.n: 紹介し is 紹介する with する changed to し so ながら can follow.

3.9.n: ながら attaches to 紹介し to show introducing items happens alongside spending her day.

4.0.n: Here はい is a conversational transition, not an answer to a yes-or-no question.

4.2.n: This identifies the day she plans to spend filming and showing items.

4.3.n: は makes 今日 the topic: she is explaining her plans for today.

4.4.n: 過ごす becomes 過ごして, followed by いく for moving forward through time and たい for wanting to.

4.5.n: と marks her preceding wish as what she thinks or intends.

4.6.n: The polite form of 思う; paired with たいと, it softly states her plan.

0.tip: ま and こと together form the name まこと, not two separate words.

1.lit: Today too, a vlog, I think I want to go ahead and film.
1.tip: たいと思います is a common, gentle way to announce what you would like or plan to do.

2.lit: Today, this top that I am wearing now is Petit Bateau, you see, but…
2.tip: 私が今着ている comes before トップス and describes it: the top I am wearing now.

3.lit: While introducing Petit Bateau’s items within the vlog…
3.tip: ながら links introducing the items to spending the day in the next line.

4.lit: Okay, as for today, I think I want to go on spending the day.
4.tip: The previous line’s ながら supplies the accompanying activity: she will spend her day while introducing the items.
